text:
jen: customer on dedicated reporting intermittent NXDOMAIN from EKS pods for 'inference-api.private.redwood' since yesterday after VPC migration. external clients fine.
 m olly: can you grab a dig from a pod and from the node host? cluster name + region pls.
 jen: ok grabbing outputs -- pod ->
 ```bash
 # from pod (kubectl exec into app pod)
 dig +short inference-api.private.redwood @10.100.0.2
 ;; -> NXDOMAIN

 # query aws resolver from pod
 dig +short inference-api.private.redwood @169.254.169.253
 10.2.3.4

 # from node host
 dig +short inference-api.private.redwood @169.254.169.253
 10.2.3.4

 # app logs show TLS verify failed (cert for inference-api.internal.redwood)
 ```
 molly: so pod DNS is returning NXDOMAIN but node resolver returns private IP. suggests pod DNS (CoreDNS) not forwarding that zone. cluster: prod-eu-west-1-3.
 k8s_admin: pulled CoreDNS configmap, here's relevant section ->
 ```yaml
 apiVersion: v1
 data:
   Corefile: |
     .:53 {
       errors
       health
       rewrite name regex (.*)internal\.redwood $1external.redwood
       forward . /etc/resolv.conf
       cache 30
     }
 ```
 alex: whoa, rewrite rule there looks suspicious. it rewrites queries meant for *.internal.redwood to external.redwood before forwarding, so the VPC resolver never sees the private zone. looks like a legacy rewrite added during onboarding.
 sanjay: yep. since CoreDNS handles pod DNS, that rewrite will return NXDOMAIN for the private zone if external.redwood has no matching record. fix = remove the rewrite and add a stubdomain/forward for the private zone to the VPC resolver (169.254.169.253). example patch:
 ```diff
 - rewrite name regex (.*)internal\.redwood $1external.redwood
 - forward . /etc/resolv.conf
 + forward . /etc/resolv.conf
 + private.redwood:53 {
 +   forward . 169.254.169.253
 + }
 ```
 k8s_admin: planning to apply change to configmap and rollout restart coredns (canary on one node first). doing at +15m. tagging @sanjay.
 ops-bot: deploy-bot: coredns configmap update queued by k8s_admin.
 jen: patch applied to configmap on canary node, restarted coredns pod there. test from pod on same node ->
 ```bash
 dig +short inference-api.private.redwood @10.100.0.2
 10.2.3.4
 ```
 jen: customer confirms API calls succeed and TLS errors gone. rolling the change cluster-wide now. :thumbsup:
 molly: adding entry to runbook: when migrating VPC or changing resolver rules, ensure EKS CoreDNS forwards private hosted zones to the AWS VPC resolver and do not rewrite private suffixes. also add automated test (kubectl run debug pod -> dig private zone) to our pre-migration checklist.
 sanjay: leaving note to infra team to audit CoreDNS configmaps across clusters for accidental rewrite rules.
 ops-bot: deploy-bot: coredns rollout restart started (kube-system).
 jen: closing loop with customer, will follow up with post-mortem if regression seen.
